name: authengentic
description: Write plain, human-sounding technical and professional prose: merges SimpleEnglish's ASD-STE100 discipline with agent-style, humanizer, and sepia's AI-tell catalogs into one non-fiction ruleset.

interface.longDescription: Load the merged authengentic writing rules automatically for documentation, procedures, error messages, runbooks, release notes, PR/issue replies, postmortems, tickets, and technical articles.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite this technical text with authengentic.
Write this release note with authengentic.
Check this document for authengentic violations.
